# Galaxy Tool Submission

Use this skill after the scientific tool and parameters have been selected. Build
complex inputs from the selected wrapper's live schema and verify the created job
resolved the intended objects.

## Dataset Inputs

- Wait for uploaded data to reach `ok` with the expected datatype before using
  the final history dataset ID.
- Verify paired mates use distinct dataset IDs and preserve forward/reverse
  order.
- For reference-source conditionals, confirm the job resolved the intended
  history reference or built-in genome rather than a default branch.

## Nested And Repeated Payloads

- Use input format `21.01` for natural nested JSON, repeat lists, and conditional
  objects. Use legacy format onl

TIP: If your data is not TAB delimited, use Text Manipulation->Convert

Syntax

This tool allows you to group the input dataset by a particular column and perform aggregate functions: Mean, Median, Mode, Sum, Max, Min, Count, Concatenate, and Randomly pick on any column(s).

The Concatenate function will take, for each group, each item in the specified column and build a comma delimited list. Concatenate Unique will do the same but will build a list of unique items with no repetition.

Count and Count Unique are equivalent to Concatenate and Concatenate Unique, but will only count the number of items and will return an integer.

  • If multiple modes are present, all are reported.

from decimal import Decimal
values={}
with open('/workspace/galaxy_datamash_output.tsv',encoding='utf-8') as f:
    header=next(f).rstrip('\\n').split('\\t')
    for line in f:
        fields=line.rstrip('\\n').split('\\t')

            values[fields[0]]=Decimal(fields[1])
wt=values['Wildtype']
mut=values['ΔlasR']
reduction=(wt-mut)/wt*Decimal(100)
print('wildtype_mean='+str(wt))
print('delta_lasR_mean='+str(mut))
print('percent_reduction='+str(reduction))
print('rounded_1dp='+format(reduction,'0.1f')+'%')
